ValidationRule.description: If Status is not Unissued but Voided, unissued but voided date should not be changed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT(ISPICKVAL( Coupon_Status__c, "Unissued but Voided" )) && ISCHANGED( Coupon_Unissued_but_Voided_Date__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Coupon Unissued but Voided Date can only be set when setting the Coupon Status to Unissued but Voided
